notes.title: EVIL CORPORATION™ UPDATE VOL. 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973527/b6f651e261d143e11c007c09d6be3a43df0694ff.png[/img]
[b]
Evil Corporation™[/b] has arrived to peddle junk food, monster energy drinks and other Weapons of Mass Destruction to unsuspecting trick-or-treaters. Fashionably late for halloween (6 months), Evil Corp executives couldn't give less of a heck as they only care about profit margins and lining their own pockets, even if it means poisoning literal children. If you ask me, they went way too far with this one..
[h1]
New stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*] RAGE SNAX - The totally not evil food and beverage company bringing you MEGA DAMAGE, available through vending machines or chance drops from mystery boxes
[*] Credits sequence to credit all of the Original Gangsters who support the show
[/list]
[h1]
Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed falling stars
[*] Removed firestarters
[*] Fixed player hitbox, bouncing is now more consistent
[*] Retuned audio
[*] Temporarily testing a faster gif loader by reducing color quality
[*] More blood decals and gore
[*] Darkness does not spawn close to you anymore, nor will it ever spawn inside a door
[*] Boxes do not spawn inside stuff anymore
[*] Picking up weapons is now easier
[*] Style points no longer available in the intro sequence
[*] App does not reveal an error popup on app close anymore
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates from the most hated inter-dimensional conglomerate Evil Corporation™

notes.title: AMD driver hotfix
notes.content:
Attempting to fix recent AMD driver crashes by disabling legacy fullscreen by default.

If you have a recent AMD GPU, borderless fullscreen will give you zero input lag, however fullscreen will crash.
For older Nvidia and Intel, legacy fullscreen may reduce input lag.

The game will always start in windowed mode for the time being. Fullscreen can be toggled in the options menu.

tags.bug: Attempting to fix recent AMD driver crashes by disabling legacy fullscreen by default.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE V0.3
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added leaderboards; DEATHTRIP is now competitive!
[*] Tested gamepad support. Works with Steam Input mapper, which you can find by pressing Shift + Tab to bring up Steam Overlay. Tested on an Xbox controller. Gyro controls are heavily recommended for precise strafing
[*] Added a stage select menu
[*] Changed window mode to AutoNoVsync to support more systems
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] New darkness enemy that slows down time in proximity to it, functions as a safe-haven for the player
[*] Lowered difficulty in beginning stages
[*] New "Love" power-up that doubles your fire-rate
[*] Mystery boxes are slightly more common
[*] Rocket launcher is slightly more rare
[*] Style points; After doing a bounce, if your speed increases in the next second, you gain 1,000 points
[*] Finishing the game will net 1,000,000 points
[*] Skullheads and some other enemies now emit sound for more auditory awareness
[*] Bombers have been nerfed
[*] Bounce now refreshes double-jump
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous notes[/h3]
Running windowed mode feels slow. Fullscreen feels 10x more responsive on my machine. Regarding controller support, it works! But- the game relies on Source style movement mechanics, as seen in CS2 for example, a game notorious for being almost impossible to play with a controller. Gyro controls should make it allot more doable.

[h3]Coming soon[/h3]
[list]
[*] October - V0.4 Halloween special
[/list]

notes.title: OVERKILL UPDATE
notes.content:
Yo thanks everyone for playing and testing! Thankful for all the feedback, both brutal and positive! Hope I can get close to version 1.0 in the coming weeks, but in the meantime, I've decided to make the game MORE FUN!

What's new:
[list]
[*]Can carry multiple weapons, scrapped weapon drop system
[*]Weapon drops are more common
[*]Added a text section that shows how many points you have
[*]Getting high off the pills now grants you temporary invulnerability
[*]Deathtripping does not make you drop your weapon anymore, so you don't need to look for it
[*]Added a small intro stage for players to test the movement mechanics
[*]After the intro stage is done, you spawn armed, so less downtime!
[/list]

Deathtripping does not make you drop your weapon anymore, so you don't need to look for it

After the intro stage is done, you spawn armed, so less downtime!
